meta.title: Specialized Invoice Types (Freight, CHA): refused for a user without the AP Executive role
gaps: Open or use Specialized Invoice Types for Freight and CHA invoices
Verify refusal or absence for a user without the AP Executive role
Repeat as an AP Executive and verify the feature is available
Compare both role outcomes in the same Enterprise tenant
